h: Priestly Blessing Turns Wealth Wisdom and Strength Toward Hashem

p: It is brought in Sefer HaZechus
by the author of Chiddushei HaRim, may the memory of the tzaddik be a blessing,
the reason that there is Midrash Rabbah
more than on the other parshiyos:
the time of the giving of our Torah;
in words of Torah on this Shabbos.
And one can say the reason for this
is stated the mitzvah of Birkas Kohanim,
and the main flow of the blessing
in the root of his soul;
and it is known that the root of the souls of the Kohanim
is to impart words of Torah
"They shall teach Your laws to Yaakov
"The Torah of truth was in his mouth."
a flow of the Oral Torah,
And indeed the very meaning of the words
כִּי ג׳ הַבְּרָכוֹת שֶׁל בִּרְכַּת כֹּהֲנִים
For the three blessings of Birkas Kohanim,
correspond to the three good gifts
that were created in the world:
as it says in the Midrash
that if one merited one of them,
he has taken the most desirable thing in the whole world.
When they are gifts of Heaven
and come through the power of the Torah, etc.
"Let not the wise man glory in his wisdom,
nor the strong man in his strength,
nor the rich man in his wealth," etc.,
that is, when these three gifts
and this is the meaning of
"when they come through the power of the Torah."
And on this one can allude
the three blessings of Birkas Kohanim
that they should come through the power of the Torah,
That is, "May He bless you," etc.,
corresponds to the gift of wealth,
as it says in the Midrash
and specifically that it be through the power of the Torah.
so that it not draw him away from words of Torah,
"And your heart will grow haughty and you will forget," etc.
וְכֵן בִּיקֵּשׁ שְׁלֹמֹה הַמֶּלֶךְ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
And so King Shlomo, peace be upon him, requested
lest I be sated and deny," etc.;
but rather that wealth be a cause
as with the wealth of the holy Avos,
and not the silver and gold of Avimelech"
with Rav Nachman, son-in-law of the house of the Nasi,
who would travel in a golden carriage,
"As long as I have not drunk a revi'is of wine,
"and as long as I have not eaten the meat of an ox";
at the aspect of "understanding and knowing Me,"
"May Hashem shine His face upon you"
corresponds to the gift of wisdom,
as it says in the Midrash:
"that He enlighten your eyes and your heart in Torah."
even from the wisdom of the Torah
there does not come from it
so it was for David and so for Avshalom";
and as it says in the Yerushalmi
"Go ask of the Urim and Tumim,
and you will find them matching my words."
For his counsel according to the Torah
it was good according to Avshalom's path.
But because the essence of his wisdom
was not to arrive through it
לָכֵן נֶאֱבַד עַל יְדֵי זֶה מִן הָעוֹלָם
therefore he was lost from the world through it,
"He gave orders to his household and strangled himself."
And on this it says "and be gracious to you":
that the wisdom and the words of Torah
should be for you a finding of favor, etc.,
"For they are a garland of grace for your head."
"May Hashem lift His face toward you"
corresponds to the gift of strength;
that is, as our Sages, of blessed memory, said
And this is the essential power of strength
שֶׁל מִלְחַמְתָּהּ שֶׁל תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה
in the battle of the Oral Torah,
as our Sages, of blessed memory, said
on the pasuk "mighty men who wage war":
וְכִי מַה גְּבוּרָה יֵשׁ בִּבְנֵי אָדָם
"For in much wisdom is much anger":
that through much wisdom of the Oral Torah
drag him to the study hall."
Hashem, may He be blessed, suppresses His anger
and His face of wrath from the person;
you will be esteemed before Him, may He be blessed,
as our Sages, of blessed memory, said:
that through this you will merit
from the enticement of the evil inclination;
כִּי זֶהוּ עִיקַּר שְׁלוֹמוֹ שֶׁל הָאָדָם
for this is the main peace of a person,
"There is no peace in my bones," etc.;
and as our Sages, of blessed memory, said
"If your enemy is hungry, feed him bread"
He will make him at peace with you;
that is, that he will be at peace with you;
and this is alluded to in
